description.narrative: This activity Procurement of Services for Supporting DFID's partnership with China on International Development, covering a range of Millennium Development Goals sectors. is a component of International Development Support Project reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £1,785,977. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Public sector policy and administrative management, Trade policy and administrative management, Family planning, Promotion of development awareness (non-sector allocable), Water sector policy and administrative management, Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution.
